description: Fork of exp362 (best=1.3390) with Q/K = [256, 192, 192, 192, 192, 192] — only L0 bumped from 192 to 256. Sum=1216 (+5.6% vs flat 1152). Motivated by exp371 grad-norm diagnostic showing L0 Q/K retains 80-100x higher grad/latent ratio than L5 at step 4900 (signal: L0 still under capacity pressure). Previous Q/K experiments only tested REDUCING L0 or all-layer changes — this is the first test of L0-only INCREASE.
